name: Tree layout retains nodes and usable edges
description: Keeps 300 leaves and malformed drafts visible without overlapping cards; missing, cyclic and ambiguous parents produce no invented edges.

passage.quote: Incomplete drafts remain inspectable. A description without a usable parent appears separately rather than being attached to an invented parent; malformed relationships are still reported as project problems. The overview does not repair project content or require a valid finished tree before it can be opened.
